What We Do

Our Services

From emergency repairs to full re-roofs and scaffold erection, we cover every aspect of roofing and access solutions.

01
Roof Repairs
Leak detection and repair, broken tiles, flashing replacement, ridge and hip work. Fast response to prevent further damage to your property.
02
Full Re-Roofing
Complete roof strip and replacement using quality slate, clay, or concrete tiles. Fully specified to meet building regulations and manufacturer guarantees.
03
Scaffolding Erection
Safe, certified scaffolding for residential and commercial projects. Designed and erected to NASC standards by trained operatives.
04
Guttering & Fascias
UPVC and cast iron guttering, fascias, soffits, and bargeboards. Supply and fit or repair of existing systems to keep water away from your property.
05
Flat Roofing
GRP fibreglass, felt, and EPDM rubber flat roof systems. Long-life solutions for extensions, garages, and commercial buildings.
06
Chimney Work
Repointing, stack rebuilds, lead flashing, cowl installation, and chimney removal. All work carried out to a high standard from scaffold.

About Us

Built On Reputation

A2B Roofing and Scaffolding Ltd is a fully insured, family-run business serving the East Midlands. We take pride in every job — from a single tile repair to a full commercial re-roof. No cowboys, no shortcuts.

Fully Insured & Compliant
Full public liability and employers' liability insurance. All work meets current building regulations.
Fast Response Times
We understand that roof problems can't wait. Emergency call-outs available 24 hours a day.
No Job Too Big or Small
From a single slate replacement to full scaffold contracts for large commercial builds.

How It Works

From Quote to Completion

Straightforward, hassle-free process from your first call to the finished job.

01
Get in Touch
Call, WhatsApp, or fill in our quote form. We'll get back to you quickly to discuss your requirements.
02
Free Survey
We visit your property, assess the work required, and provide a clear, itemised written quotation at no charge.
03
Scaffold Up
Where required, we erect a safe working scaffold before any roof work begins — no compromise on safety.
04
Job Completed
Work completed to a high standard, site left clean and tidy. All waste materials removed from your property.
